title: luoluoAI
brief: luoluoAI is a multi-model API gateway offering GPT, Claude, and Grok through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with familiar SDKs, a console for keys, balance, and usage, and pay-as-you-go top-ups via Stripe. It advertises up to 90% off list prices on its model plaza. - Warning: the discount figures are the vendor's own and unverified; plainskill in the thread called the pricing "crap", so community reception is mixed.
caveat: It advertises up to 90% off list prices on its model plaza. - Warning: the discount figures are the vendor's own and unverified; plainskill in the thread called the pricing "crap", so community reception is mixed.
details: luoluoAI is a multi-model API gateway that puts GPT, Claude, and Grok behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.luoluocoder.com/v1, so existing SDK code works with a base-URL change. Its model plaza lists live per-token prices, advertising steep discounts such as GPT-6 Astra at 0.10x list and Claude Opus 5 at 0.20x, with pay-as-you-go top-ups via Stripe and a console for keys, balance, and usage. It also runs a Discord community where new users can claim free credits. The discount figures are the vendor's own and unverified, and community reception in the CheapInfra thread was mixed.
